metaDescription: Kevin jokes that if Jeffrey Epstein were frozen through cryonics, he would be at Alcor, the best-known cryonics provider.
summary: Kevin speculates in this short that if Jeffrey Epstein were serious about cryonics, he would go to Alcor, which Kevin calls the best in the industry. Kevin says Epstein only works with the best, so if he were frozen he would be at Alcor, and adds the same would apply to Charlie Kirk. The remark is framed as speculation, not a claim of fact.
